rules.statement: A debtor has the right to pay his debt and redeem a mortgage bond securing the debt, which can be exercised through an agent without needing privity of contract between the first mortgagee and the new creditor.
rules.supporting_quote: "The debtor, in the present case, seeks to pay the debt and redeem the earlier bond through his duly constituted agent, the plaintiff. No privity of contract between the first mortgagee and the plaintiff need exist to enable the latter to act as the debtor's agent."
